meta.description: Curated weapon effects recovered from PDF bio/WEAPON MATERIAL EFFECTS leaks and base-monster inheritance.

fixes.name: Rubbery Hide+
fixes.weaponEffect: While holding your weapon, you can speak a command word and transform it into a fishing pole with a hook, a line, and a reel. You have a +1 bonus to checks to catch fish while using this fishing pole. Speaking the command word again changes the fishing pole back into the weapon.

fixes.name: Gypceros Wing
fixes.weaponEffect: While attuned to this weapon, you know the poison spray cantrip. if you already know the cantrip, the spell's range increases to 60 feet.

fixes.name: Novacrystal
fixes.weaponEffect: Blindsider. While attuned to this weapon, creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against being Blinded from effects and attacks caused by you.

fixes.name: Gypceros Tail
fixes.weaponEffect: Resentment. Until the end of your turn, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls against any creature that has damaged you since the end of your last turn.

fixes.name: T.Gypceros Head
fixes.weaponEffect: While attuned to this weapon, you can conjure a hooded lantern as an action. The lantern hovers 10 feet off the ground and stays within 5 feet of you. While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's bright light. You can use an action to lower the hood, reducing the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.

fixes.name: Malfestio Grandwing
fixes.weaponEffect: (Bard, druid, sorcerer, wizard only) While attuned to this weapon you can cast the confusion spell once a day, without expending a spell slot.

fixes.name: Malfestio Tailblade
fixes.weaponEffect: This weapon has 4 runes. It regains 1d4 expended runes daily at dawn. When you hit a creature with this weapon you can expend a rune to outline the target in a blue glow, that only you can see, for 1 minute. While the creature is outlined, you can always see them, even if they are invisible, so long as they are not behind full cover.

fixes.name: Nightcloak Grandwing
fixes.weaponEffect: While you are holding this weapon, you can use an action to speak its command word to summon a giant owl for up to 8 hours. The owl can telepathically communicate with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence. Once this property has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

fixes.name: Malfestio Goldfeather+
fixes.weaponEffect: Nightcloak Soul. While you are attuned to this weapon you gain the following benefits: You can reload as a free action. You can set pitfall traps or shock traps as a bonus action. Your weapon attacks critical hit range is increased by 1. You can use a bonus action to conjure two earplugs in the shape of your choice.

fixes.name: Marbled Hump
fixes.weaponEffect: (Monk Only) Your stunning strike save DC increases by 3, but it no longer stuns. Instead, a creature that fails its saving throw is incapacitated.

fixes.name: R.Duram Hardtail
fixes.weaponEffect: Awaken. When this material is placed in a weapon that does not deal cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or thunder damage, it rolls one additional damage die when it hits. For example, a shortsword now rolls 2d6 and a greatsword deals 3d6.

fixes.name: Duramboros Hardhorn
fixes.weaponEffect: Shotplus+. Your normal ammo deals an extra 3 damage.

fixes.name: Duram Sacrum
fixes.weaponEffect: (Ranged Weapon Only) Deadeye+. Your weapon's normal attack range is doubled.

fixes.name: Durambolite
fixes.weaponEffect: Rust. When you hit a creature for the first time on your turn, its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn.

fixes.name: Elderfrost Trunkspine
fixes.weaponEffect: While attuned to this weapon you can use an action to speak its command word to exhale shards of ice in a 30foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once used, this property cannot be used again until you finish a long rest.

fixes.name: Gammoth Hardfang
fixes.weaponEffect: (Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, & Wizard Only) This weapon has 10 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its runes to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: Cone of Cold (5 runes), Fog Cloud (1 runes), Ice Storm (4 runes), or Wall of Ice (4 runes). This weapon regains 1d6 + 4 expended runes daily at dawn. If you expend the weapon's last rune, roll a d20. On a 1, the runes cannot recharge for a week.

fixes.name: Gammoth Ice Orb
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d8 cold damage.

fixes.name: Gammoth Pallium
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d8 cold damage.

fixes.name: A.Kecha Leadbone
fixes.weaponEffect: (Gunlance Only) Artillery+. While attuned to this weapon, your wyvernfire can now be used twice per long rest and you can add your Strength modifier to the damage of your shell attacks.

fixes.name: A.Kecha Lash
fixes.weaponEffect: This weapon has 6 runes and regains 1d6 runes daily at dawn. You can use a bonus action to shoot a spark out of the weapon at a creature, up to 60 feet away. The targeted creature must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become burned for 1 minute. A burned creature takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of their turn.

fixes.name: A.Kecha Auricle
fixes.weaponEffect: When you cast a spell that deals fire damage, it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.

fixes.name: A.Kecha Ripper
fixes.weaponEffect: (Bladed Weapon Only) Razor Sharp. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with this weapon, anytime it would regain hit points before the end of its next turn, it regains half as many. Additionally, if the creature is afflicted with a wound, such as the odogaron's bloody wound, it can only be closed by magical healing for 1 minute.

fixes.name: T.Ebony Plate
fixes.weaponEffect: Latent Power +2. When you are reduced to a half of your maximum hit points for the first time in combat or at the start of your turn on the 10th round of combat, whichever comes first, you gain the effects of the haste spell for 1 minute. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use this property again.

fixes.name: T.Ebony Gem
fixes.weaponEffect: Chain Crit. Every consecutive hit on a creature increases your crit range by 1 until you score a critical hit, miss an attack, or hit a different creature.

fixes.name: Juv.Astalos Membrane
fixes.weaponEffect: When you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, you gain a +1 bonus to its spell attack roll.

fixes.name: Y.Barioth Cortex
fixes.weaponEffect: In freezing temperatures, this weapon sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of you. This property can be used no more than once per hour.

fixes.name: Y.Barioth Fur
fixes.weaponEffect: While you are attuned to this weapon and you cast a spell that is a water or ice themed, it is cast as if it was one spell level higher. A spell cannot be increased beyond level 6 with this effect.

fixes.name: Y.Barioth Talon
fixes.weaponEffect: (Bow Only) As a bonus action you can freeze the air in your palm into an icicle nock it to your bow. The icicle acts as a normal armor, but when you hit a creature with this icicle, it deals cold damage instead of piercing damage.

fixes.name: Freezer Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: (Light Bowgun Only) When you hit a creature with your water ammo it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or have its movement speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn on a failed save. On a successful save, the creature's movement speed is reduced by 10 feet.

fixes.name: Y.Barioth Spike
fixes.weaponEffect: When you hit a creature with this weapon it must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be diseased with Iceblight until the end of its next turn.

fixes.name: Y.Barioth Tail
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Element (cold). When you critically hit with a weapon or spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d4 cold damage. Additionally, if a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more against a spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d4 cold damage to it.

fixes.name: Small Amber Tusks
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 cold damage.

fixes.name: S.Barioth Cortex
fixes.weaponEffect: While attuned to this weapon, sand and dust whip around it like a micro dust devil.

fixes.name: S.Barioth Fur
fixes.weaponEffect: (Spellcaster only) This weapon has 4 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: mirror image (2 charges), or wall of sand (2 charges). The weapon regains 1d4 expended runes daily at dawn. If you expend the weapon's last rune, roll a d20. On a 1, you can't regain any runes on this weapon for 1 week.

fixes.name: S.Barioth Talon
fixes.weaponEffect: Your Dexterity score is 16 while attuned to this weapon. It has no effect on you if your Dexterity is already 16 or higher.

fixes.name: Rugged Pleura
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 slashing damage.

fixes.name: S.Barioth Lash
fixes.weaponEffect: (Druid, Sorcerer, & Wizard only) This weapon has 6 runes. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its runes to cast the dust devil spell from it. For 1 rune, you cast the 2nd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional rune you expend. The weapon regains 1d6 + 1 expended runes daily at dawn. If you expend the weapon's last rune, roll a d20. On a 1, you can't regain any runes on this weapon for 1 week.

fixes.name: Hvy Indigo Tusks
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d8 slashing damage.

fixes.name: Black Diablos Carapace
fixes.weaponEffect: KO+. When this material is placed into a hammer, it gains one addition use of its mighty weapon property. Additionally, when a creature must succeed on a saving throw or become stunned by the effect of one of your weapon attacks, they make the save with disadvantage.

fixes.name: Black Diablos Fang
fixes.weaponEffect: FastCharge+. When you roll for initiative, your greatsword, longsword, or charge blade gains 2 charge, spirit, or phial charge.

fixes.name: Black Diablos Shell
fixes.weaponEffect: Partbreaker+3. You deal an extra 1d10 damage when you critically hit with this weapon.

fixes.name: Black Diablos Ridge
fixes.weaponEffect: Resentment. Until the end of your turn, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls against any creature that has damaged you since the end of your last turn.

fixes.name: Diablos Hardtail
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d10 piercing damage.

fixes.name: Blos Medulla
fixes.weaponEffect: Charger. When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to shove a creature.

fixes.name: Blackcurl Horn
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Draw+. During the first round of combat your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 15 or higher.

fixes.name: Black Spiral Horn
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 2d6 piercing damage.

fixes.name: Diablos Brainstem
fixes.weaponEffect: Awaken+. When this material is placed in a weapon that does not deal cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or thunder damage, it rolls two extra damage die when it hits.

fixes.name: Gravios Carapace+
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d10 fire damage.

fixes.name: Gravios Wing
fixes.weaponEffect: When you hit a Huge or smaller creature with this weapon, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength check or be pushed back 5 feet.

fixes.name: Conflagrant Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: When you cast a spell that deals 10 or more fire damage while attuned to this weapon, it summons a nitrotoad in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target or in a space within the area of effect. If you deal more than 30 fire damage, it instead summons a giant nitrotoad.

fixes.name: G.Coma Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: (Spellcaster Only) This weapon has 10 runes and regains 1d6 + 4 runes daily at dusk. While holding it, you can cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and the spell's normal casting time: dream (5 runes), fear (3 runes), modify memory (5 runes), phantasmal killer (4 runes), or sleep (1 rune per spell level). If you expend the last rune it cannot regain any runes for one week.

fixes.name: Gravios Pleura
fixes.weaponEffect: (Hunting Horn Only) Muse. When you finish a long rest choose one creature to become your muse until you start a long rest. Your muse gains the magical benefits of your completed melody while they are within 120 feet of you.

fixes.name: Gravios Skull
fixes.weaponEffect: Peak Performance. When your hit points are full and you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for an attack you make with a melee weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

fixes.name: Gravios Medulla+
fixes.weaponEffect: (Ranged Weapon Only) While attuned to this weapon your ammo and coatings change in the following ways: Bow. You blast coating radius increases to 15 feet. Dual Repeaters. Your blaze ammo is always empowered. Heavy Bowgun. Your cluster ammo deals an extra 2d6 fire damage. Light Bowgun. Creatures hit by your flaming ammo catch fire, taking 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until a creature uses an action to douse the flame.

fixes.name: Allfire Stone
fixes.weaponEffect: While you are attuned to this weapon, you can use an action to gain the same benefits as a potion of cloud giant's strength for 10 minutes. Once you use this property, you cannot use it again for 1 week.

fixes.name: Gravios Jewel
fixes.weaponEffect: You gain a + 2 bonus to your spell attack rolls and spell save DC while attuned to this weapon. This bonus increases to +3 when the spell you are casting deals fire damage.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Scale
fixes.weaponEffect: Quick Sheath. While attuned to this weapon, you can always sheath it as a free action even if you have already drawn a weapon as part of your move action.

fixes.name: Silver Inferno Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d10 fire damage.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Carapace
fixes.weaponEffect: Weakness Exploit+. When you have advantage on an attack roll with this weapon and you hit the target; you can have your weapon deal its maximum damage if the lower of the two d20 rolls would also hit the target (all extra damage dice must still be rolled). You can use this property a number of times equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice), regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Marrow
fixes.weaponEffect: You can use a bonus action to speak this weapon's command word, causing flames to erupt from the weapon. These flames shed bright light in a 50-foot radius and dim light for an additional 50 feet.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Tail
fixes.weaponEffect: Spirit. When fighting a Huge or larger creature, this weapon deals 1d6 extra weapon damage and its crit range is increased by 1.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Wing
fixes.weaponEffect: (Range Weapon Only) Ammo Up. Your bowgun's normal ammo capacity doubles while you are attuned to this weapon. Additionally, when coating, you can coat up to 10 additional arrows.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Plate
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Boost+. You can roll two additional weapon damage dice when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with a weapon attack.

fixes.name: Silver Rathalos Ruby
fixes.weaponEffect: Mind's Eye. Your attacks with this weapon bypass the damage resistances of any creature.

fixes.name: Conflagrant Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: When you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you gain a +2 bonus to its spell attack roll and it deal an extra 1d4 fire damage.

fixes.name: P.Rathian Spike
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Eye. Your weapon attacks critical hit range is increased by 1.

fixes.name: P.Rathian Tail
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage.

fixes.name: P.Rath Wingtalon
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Element (fire and poison). When you critically hit with a weapon or spell that deals fire or poison damage, you deal an extra 1d6 damage of that type.

fixes.name: P.Rathian Plate
fixes.weaponEffect: When you hit a creature with this weapon, they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of its next turn.

fixes.name: P.Rathian Ruby
fixes.weaponEffect: While you hold your weapon, you gain +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and you ignore half cover when making a spell attack.

fixes.name: Hirabami Webbing
fixes.weaponEffect: This weapon has three runes that it regains daily at dawn. When you hit a creature with this weapon it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

fixes.name: Freezer Sac+
fixes.weaponEffect: Your cold spells deal an extra 1d4 cold damage.

fixes.name: Hirabami Tail Claw
fixes.weaponEffect: When a creature attempts to escape your grapple, you can use your reaction to give the creature disadvantage on their skill check. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Strength modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

fixes.name: Hirabami Gem
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Element (cold). When you critically hit with a weapon or spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d6 cold damage. Additionally, if a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more against a spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d6 cold damage to it.

fixes.name: Hirabami Webbing
fixes.weaponEffect: This weapon has three runes that it regains daily at dawn. When you hit a creature with this weapon it must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.

fixes.name: Freezer Sac+
fixes.weaponEffect: Your cold spells deal an extra 1d4 cold damage.

fixes.name: Hirabami Tail Claw
fixes.weaponEffect: When a creature attempts to escape your grapple, you can use your reaction to give the creature disadvantage on their skill check. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Strength modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

fixes.name: Hirabami Gem
fixes.weaponEffect: Critical Element (cold). When you critically hit with a weapon or spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d6 cold damage. Additionally, if a creature fails its saving throw by 5 or more against a spell that deals cold damage, you deal an extra 1d6 cold damage to it.

fixes.name: Royal Poison Sac
fixes.weaponEffect: Your weapon deals an extra 1d6 poison damage.

fixes.name: R.Ludroth Tail+
fixes.weaponEffect: When you hit a creature with this weapon, they must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned with Waterblight until the end of its next turn.

fixes.name: P.Ludroth Crest
fixes.weaponEffect: (Spellcaster only) This weapon has 4 runes While wielding this weapon, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its runes to cast one of the following Spells from it, using your spell save DC: chromatic orb (poison) (1 rune), ray of sickness (1 rune), dragon's breath (poison or cold) (2 runes), or protection from poison (2 runes).
